hero.lead: A nation of 131.9 million where World Bank Group operations have helped mobilise nearly $12 billion of private capital, and a $500 million guarantee is drawing more into infrastructure.

capital.heading: Mexico draws private capital at scale. Next, safe water in every home.

register.text: A guarantee that lets private lenders finance Mexican infrastructure on better terms.

assets.heading: Five assets no balance sheet counts.

items.name: The People
items.label: Citizens, 2025
items.text: 80 in every hundred live in towns and cities; the rest live on the land they farm and fish.
items.alt: A busy street in Mexico City

items.name: The Land
items.label: Of land in farms and pasture
items.text: The land that feeds the nation, and the first place a citizen dividend can be earned.
items.alt: Agave fields in the highlands of Jalisco, Mexico

items.name: The Forest
items.label: Of land under forest
items.text: Standing forest holds the water, soil and carbon that the world will pay to keep.
items.alt: Pine and oak forest in the mountains of Michoacan, Mexico

items.name: The Water
items.label: Renewable fresh water per person
items.text: Enough to supply every home, once it is stored, treated and piped.
items.alt: Turquoise water of a cenote in the Yucatan, Mexico

items.name: The Power
items.label: Of energy from renewables, 2021
items.text: Sun, wind, water and biomass already carry part of the load; the rest is the opportunity.
items.alt: A solar park in the Sonoran desert, Mexico

items.name: The enterprises building Perfect Mexico
items.text: The Stewards are verifying the companies and social enterprises already delivering the seven basic living standards in Mexico. Suggest one to include.

coverage.gap_text: Mexicans without safely managed drinking water at home: 57 in every hundred.
